verdict.rationale: DBOS docs say the Conductor management API is "OpenAPI-described", so a first-party machine-readable spec exists for Conductor's workflow, queue and schedule management. However, no download location is documented, and a probe of common spec paths on docs.dbos.dev returned 404. That probe only tested guessed paths on the docs site, so it does not concretely contradict the claim; it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: a documented, downloadable spec URL or artifact; independent confirmation that the spec is retrievable; and any spec covering the core library or DBOSClient interfaces beyond Conductor.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Conductor's workflow, queue, and schedule management is available over an OpenAPI-described HTTP API and from the dbosctl command-line client
register applications with Conductor and tune their settings, search workflows, cancel or fork them, inspect queues and schedules
